{"metadata":{"kernelspec":{"display_name":"Python 3","language":"python","name":"python3"},"language_info":{"name":"python"}},"nbformat_minor":5,"nbformat":4,"cells":[{"id":"title","cell_type":"markdown","source":"# Edge Quantum Guard (EQG)\n## Gated Real-QPU Protocol with Conditional Dynamical Decoupling\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|--------|\n| **Project** | Edge Quantum Guard (EQG) |\n| **Document type** | Methodological validation & reproducibility record |\n| **Author / rights holder** | Arturo Salvador Balderas Hernández |\n| **License** | Elastic License 2.0 (ELv2) — full text in the final cell |\n| **SPDX** | Elastic-2.0 |\n| **Execution target** | **IBM Quantum hardware only** (no CPU, no Aer, no simulator) |\n| **QPU budget** | **15 s protocol + 15 s baseline = 30 s total** |\n\n---\n\n## 1. Purpose\n\nThis notebook is the audit-ready record of **Edge Quantum Guard**: a pre-job control stack that\n\n1. observes device health from **published calibration** (0 QPU seconds),\n2. selects a conflict-aware physical layout (**Layout Guard**),\n3. decides whether to inject Dynamical Decoupling (**Conditional DD / adrenaline**),\n4. runs an open combinatorial workload on the **real QPU**, and only then\n5. authorizes an unassisted baseline if pre-registered success criteria are met.\n\nShareable outputs (`report.json`, `results_summary.txt`, `figures_summary.png`) carry metrics and plots so results can be communicated **without** distributing internal control logic.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Scientific rationale\n\nOn NISQ processors, circuit quality depends strongly on which physical qubits are used and whether idle-time decoherence is mitigated. Spending quantum processing unit (QPU) time on an unassisted baseline *before* knowing whether the assisted path is viable wastes limited quota when the assisted path already fails.\n\nThis protocol therefore adopts a **gated expenditure** design with a hard **30-second** account ceiling:\n\n```text\nArm B — EQG protocol + workload     ≤ 15 s account\n        │\n        ▼\n   pre-registered favorability gate\n        │ yes                              │ no\n        ▼                                  ▼\nArm A — same workload, no EQG           SKIP Arm A\n        ≤ 15 s account                    (preserve remaining ~15 s)\n```\n\n**Queue wait is not the same as billed QPU seconds.** Open-plan queues can take minutes of wall-clock time; `JOB_TIMEOUT_S` cancels if the job has not finished within the wall limit. Account time is estimated from shots and a conservative circuit model.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Architecture (EQG modules only)\n\n| Role | EQG module | Function |\n|------|------------|----------|\n| Eyes | **Observation Membrane** | Maps relative health scores into discrete regimes (STABLE / UNSTABLE / CONFLICT) with hysteresis |\n| Reflexes | **Layout Guard** | Selects a size-`k` physical layout that prefers healthy qubits and avoids high-crosstalk pairs |\n| Hands | **Conditional DD** | Injects Dynamical Decoupling only when mean layout health is below a fixed threshold (“adrenaline”) |\n| Workload | **QAOA MaxCut** (Qiskit, Apache-2.0) | Open combinatorial job used as the stability test |\n\n**Real-time path:** Observation Membrane → Layout Guard → Conditional DD → QAOA.\n\n**Critical separation of roles**\n\n- **Layout Guard** chooses *who* works (the initial configuration / physical qubit set).\n- **Conditional DD** chooses *how* they work (mitigation). DD does **not** select qubits and does **not** change the layout after it is fixed.\n- Layout selection excludes qubits from *this job’s circuit only*; it does not power-down or “stop” the device.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Pre-registered decisions (do not change after seeing data)\n\n| Parameter | Value | Meaning |\n|-----------|-------|---------|\n| `BUDGET_B_S` | **15** | Assisted (EQG) account ceiling |\n| `BUDGET_A_S` | **15** | Baseline ceiling (only if B favorable) |\n| `BUDGET_TOTAL_S` | **30** | Hard account limit for this test |\n| `FAVORABLE_APPROX` | 0.50 | Minimum approximation ratio for Arm B |\n| `FAVORABLE_BEST` | 2 | Minimum best cut among measured bitstrings |\n| `HEALTH_THR` | 0.92 | Below this layout health → enable DD |\n| Workload | QAOA MaxCut, n=4, p=1, C4 graph | Sized for a 15 s account window |\n| `SHOTS` | 256 | Keeps estimated account cost inside 15 s |\n| `JOB_TIMEOUT_S` | 180 | Wall wait for queue+run; then cancel |\n\n---\n\n## 5. Execution cells\n\n| Cell | Content | QPU account |\n|------|---------|-------------|\n| **1** | Install, EQG stack, connect to **real** IBM QPU | 0 s |\n| **2** | Arm B — full EQG + one real job | ≤ **15 s** |\n| **3** | Arm A — baseline alone (conditional) | ≤ **15 s** |\n| **4** | Figures, shareable tables, verdict | 0 s |\n| **5** | License (ELv2) | — |\n\nIf Cell 2 is not favorable, **do not run Cell 3**.","metadata":{}},{"id":"s1","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## Cell 1 — Installation, EQG control stack, real-QPU connection\n\n**Hardware only.** No CPU path, no Aer, no simulator. If the token or backend fails, execution stops.","metadata":{}},{"id":"cfg","cell_type":"code","source":"%pip install -q \"qiskit>=1.0\" \"qiskit-ibm-runtime>=0.30\" matplotlib scipy\n\nimport os, time, json, heapq\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional\nimport numpy as np\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n\nplt.rcParams.update({\n    \"figure.dpi\": 120, \"axes.grid\": True, \"grid.alpha\": 0.3,\n    \"axes.spines.top\": False, \"axes.spines.right\": False, \"font.size\": 10,\n})\n\n# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n# Edge Quantum Guard — HARDWARE ONLY — 15 s + 15 s = 30 s\n# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\nCHANNEL = \"ibm_cloud\"\nINSTANCE = \"open-instance\"\nBACKEND_NAME = \"ibm_fez\"\nUSE_LEAST_BUSY = False\n\nBUDGET_TOTAL_S = 30.0\nBUDGET_B_S = 15.0\nBUDGET_A_S = 15.0\nJOB_TIMEOUT_S = 180\n\nN_QUBITS = 4\nQAOA_P = 1\nSHOTS = 256\n\nFAVORABLE_APPROX = 0.50\nFAVORABLE_BEST = 2\nHEALTH_THR = 0.92\n\nOUT = Path(\"/kaggle/working/eqg\") if Path(\"/kaggle/working\").exists() else Path(\"eqg\")\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\nt_acum = 0.0\nstate = {\n    \"project\": \"Edge Quantum Guard\",\n    \"author\": \"Arturo Salvador Balderas Hernandez\",\n    \"license\": \"Elastic-2.0\",\n    \"result_b\": None, \"result_a\": None,\n    \"favorable\": False, \"fav_reason\": \"\",\n    \"layout_b\": None, \"use_dd\": False,\n    \"health\": {}, \"flags\": {},\n    \"backend\": None, \"job_ids\": [],\n}\n\ndef token() -> str:\n    try:\n        from kaggle_secrets import UserSecretsClient\n        t = UserSecretsClient().get_secret(\"IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN\")\n        if t:\n            return t.strip()\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    t = os.environ.get(\"QISKIT_IBM_TOKEN\") or os.environ.get(\"IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN\")\n    if not t:\n        raise RuntimeError(\n            \"HARDWARE ONLY: set IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN (Kaggle secret or env). No simulator.\"\n        )\n    return t.strip()\n\n# ─── EQG: Observation Membrane ───\nclass ObservationMembrane:\n    \"\"\"Hysteresis: relative anomaly → STABLE / UNSTABLE / CONFLICT.\"\"\"\n    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 13):\n        self.cap = max(8, min(int(capacity), 64))\n        self.h: List[float] = []\n        self.state = 0\n\n    def push(self, score: float) -> int:\n        self.h.append(float(score))\n        self.h = self.h[-self.cap:]\n        sm = float(np.mean(self.h))\n        if self.state == 0:\n            if sm >= 0.42: self.state = 1\n        elif self.state == 1:\n            if sm >= 0.68: self.state = 2\n            elif sm < 0.35: self.state = 0\n        else:\n            if sm < 0.58: self.state = 1\n        return self.state\n\nREGIME = [\"STABLE\", \"UNSTABLE\", \"CONFLICT\"]\n\n# ─── EQG: Layout Guard ───\ndef _make_adj(n, edges):\n    adj = [set() for _ in range(n)]\n    for u, v in edges:\n        adj[u].add(v); adj[v].add(u)\n    return adj\n\ndef _weighted_independent_set(adj, w):\n    n = len(adj); rd = [len(a) for a in adj]; alive = [True] * n\n    heap = [(-w[v] / (rd[v] + 1), v) for v in range(n)]\n    heapq.heapify(heap); S = []\n    while heap:\n        key, v = heapq.heappop(heap)\n        if not alive[v] or abs(-key - w[v] / (rd[v] + 1)) > 1e-12:\n            continue\n        S.append(v); alive[v] = False\n        for u in adj[v]:\n            if not alive[u]: continue\n            alive[u] = False\n            for x in adj[u]:\n                if alive[x]:\n                    rd[x] -= 1\n                    heapq.heappush(heap, (-w[x] / (rd[x] + 1), x))\n    return S\n\ndef _local_improve(adj, S0):\n    S = set(S0); changed = True\n    while changed:\n        changed = False\n        for u in list(S):\n            if u not in S: continue\n            cand = [v for v in adj[u] if v not in S and len(adj[v] & S) == 1]\n            for i, v in enumerate(cand):\n                ww = next((w for w in cand[i + 1:] if w not in adj[v]), None)\n                if ww is not None:\n                    S.discard(u); S |= {v, ww}; changed = True; break\n            if changed: break\n    return sorted(S)\n\ndef layout_guard(candidates, health, flags, zz_pairs, k, zz_thr=2.0):\n    \"\"\"Who works: prefer healthy qubits, avoid high-crosstalk edges.\"\"\"\n    t0 = time.perf_counter()\n    pool = [q for q in candidates if flags.get(q, 0) == 0] or list(candidates)\n    if len(pool) < k:\n        rest = sorted([q for q in candidates if q not in pool],\n                      key=lambda q: (flags.get(q, 0), -health.get(q, 0)))\n        pool += rest[: k - len(pool)]\n    idx = {q: i for i, q in enumerate(pool)}\n    edges = [(idx[a], idx[b]) for (a, b), z in zz_pairs.items()\n             if a in idx and b in idx and z >= zz_thr]\n    adj = _make_adj(len(pool), edges)\n    w = [float(health.get(q, 0.5)) for q in pool]\n    I = _local_improve(adj, _weighted_independent_set(adj, w))\n    chosen = sorted([pool[i] for i in I], key=lambda q: -health.get(q, 0))[:k]\n    if len(chosen) < k:\n        rest = [q for q in pool if q not in chosen]\n        while len(chosen) < k and rest:\n            chosen.append(rest.pop(0))\n    return sorted(chosen), (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1e3\n\ndef decide_dd(layout_health: float) -> Tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"How they work: mitigate only; does not change the layout.\"\"\"\n    if layout_health < HEALTH_THR:\n        return True, f\"adrenaline(health={layout_health:.3f}<{HEALTH_THR})\"\n    return False, f\"skip(health={layout_health:.3f}>={HEALTH_THR})\"\n\n# ─── Workload: QAOA MaxCut C4 ───\nfrom qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile\nfrom qiskit.circuit import Parameter\nfrom qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService, SamplerV2\n\nMAXCUT_EDGES = [(0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 0)]\nMAXCUT_OPT = 4.0\n\ndef maxcut_value(bitstring: str) -> float:\n    bits = str(bitstring).replace(\" \", \"\")[::-1].zfill(N_QUBITS)\n    return sum(1 for i, j in MAXCUT_EDGES if bits[i] != bits[j])\n\ndef build_qaoa(use_dd: bool = False) -> QuantumCircuit:\n    b, g = Parameter(\"b\"), Parameter(\"g\")\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(N_QUBITS, N_QUBITS)\n    qc.h(range(N_QUBITS))\n    for i, j in MAXCUT_EDGES:\n        qc.cx(i, j); qc.rz(2 * g, j); qc.cx(i, j)\n    if use_dd:\n        qc.x(range(N_QUBITS)); qc.barrier()\n        qc.x(range(N_QUBITS)); qc.barrier()\n    for q in range(N_QUBITS):\n        qc.rx(2 * b, q)\n    qc.measure(range(N_QUBITS), range(N_QUBITS))\n    return qc.assign_parameters({b: 0.4, g: 0.7})\n\ndef evaluate_counts(counts: dict) -> dict:\n    total = sum(counts.values()) or 1\n    exp_cut = 0.0; best, best_bs = 0, \"\"; hist: Dict[int, int] = {}\n    for bs, c in counts.items():\n        v = int(maxcut_value(bs))\n        exp_cut += v * (c / total)\n        hist[v] = hist.get(v, 0) + c\n        if v > best:\n            best, best_bs = v, str(bs)\n    return {\n        \"expected_cut\": float(exp_cut),\n        \"approximation_ratio\": float(exp_cut / MAXCUT_OPT),\n        \"best_cut\": int(best),\n        \"best_bitstring\": best_bs,\n        \"shots\": int(total),\n        \"cut_histogram\": {str(k): int(v) for k, v in sorted(hist.items())},\n    }\n\ndef is_favorable(res: Optional[dict]) -> Tuple[bool, str]:\n    if res is None:\n        return False, \"no result\"\n    if res[\"approximation_ratio\"] < FAVORABLE_APPROX:\n        return False, f\"approx {res['approximation_ratio']:.3f} < {FAVORABLE_APPROX}\"\n    if res[\"best_cut\"] < FAVORABLE_BEST:\n        return False, f\"best_cut {res['best_cut']} < {FAVORABLE_BEST}\"\n    return True, \"meets approx and best_cut thresholds\"\n\ndef estimate_account_s(shots: int) -> float:\n    # conservative: duration + measure + rep_delay per shot + overhead\n    return shots * (80e-6 + 1.6e-6 + 250e-6) + 2.5\n\n# ─── Connect to REAL hardware (no fallback) ───\nprint(\"Connecting to IBM Quantum — HARDWARE ONLY…\")\nservice = QiskitRuntimeService(channel=CHANNEL, token=token(), instance=INSTANCE)\n\nif USE_LEAST_BUSY:\n    backend = service.least_busy(operational=True, simulator=False, min_num_qubits=N_QUBITS)\nelse:\n    backend = service.backend(BACKEND_NAME)\n    if getattr(backend.configuration(), \"simulator\", False):\n        raise RuntimeError(f\"{BACKEND_NAME} is a simulator. HARDWARE ONLY — abort.\")\n\nstate[\"backend\"] = backend.name\nprint(f\"QPU: {backend.name}  qubits={backend.num_qubits}\")\nprint(f\"Budgets: B≤{BUDGET_B_S:.0f}s  A≤{BUDGET_A_S:.0f}s  total≤{BUDGET_TOTAL_S:.0f}s\")\nprint(f\"Shots={SHOTS}  estimated account/job ≈ {estimate_account_s(SHOTS):.2f}s\")\n\ndef run_on_qpu(qc, shots, layout):\n    \"\"\"ONE job on the real QPU. No simulator path.\"\"\"\n    global t_acum\n    t0 = time.perf_counter()\n    tc = transpile(qc, backend, initial_layout=layout, optimization_level=1)\n    job = SamplerV2(mode=backend).run([(tc, None, shots)])\n    jid = job.job_id()\n    state[\"job_ids\"].append(jid)\n    print(f\"  SUBMITTED job_id={jid}\")\n    print(f\"  Waiting on REAL QPU (wall timeout {JOB_TIMEOUT_S}s)…\")\n    print(f\"  (Queue wait ≠ billed seconds. Account billed ≈ {estimate_account_s(shots):.2f}s)\")\n    try:\n        res = job.result(timeout=JOB_TIMEOUT_S)\n    except Exception as e:\n        try:\n            job.cancel()\n            print(\"  Cancelled after timeout/error.\")\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n        raise RuntimeError(\n            f\"Real QPU job failed/timeout (job_id={jid}): {e}\\n\"\n            \"Usually queue delay on open plan — retry when the backend is freer.\"\n        ) from e\n\n    d = res[0].data\n    counts = {}\n    for key in (\"c\", \"meas\"):\n        if hasattr(d, key):\n            counts = getattr(d, key).get_counts()\n            break\n    if not counts:\n        for key in d:\n            try:\n                counts = d[key].get_counts(); break\n            except Exception:\n                continue\n    if not counts:\n        raise RuntimeError(f\"Empty counts from hardware job {jid}\")\n\n    wall = time.perf_counter() - t0\n    cost = estimate_account_s(shots)\n    t_acum += cost\n    print(f\"  DONE wall={wall:.1f}s  account+≈{cost:.2f}s  acum≈{t_acum:.2f}/{BUDGET_TOTAL_S:.0f}s\")\n    return counts, wall, jid\n\ndef observe_from_calibration():\n    \"\"\"Published properties only — 0 QPU seconds.\"\"\"\n    rows = []\n    tgt = backend.target\n    for q in range(backend.num_qubits):\n        try:\n            qp = tgt.qubit_properties[q]\n            t1 = (qp.t1 or 0) * 1e6\n            t2 = (qp.t2 or 0) * 1e6\n            if t2 > 0 and t1 > 0:\n                rows.append((q, min(t2, 2 * t1)))\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n    if not rows:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"No T1/T2 calibration on this backend.\")\n    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r[1])\n    cand = [r[0] for r in rows[:16]]\n    med = float(np.median([r[1] for r in rows[:24]]))\n    health, flags = {}, {}\n    for q, t2 in [(r[0], r[1]) for r in rows if r[0] in cand]:\n        health[q] = float(np.clip(t2 / max(med, 1e-6), 0.05, 1.0))\n        m = ObservationMembrane()\n        sc = float(np.clip(1.0 - health[q], 0, 1))\n        flags[q] = m.push(sc); flags[q] = m.push(sc)\n    zz = {}\n    try:\n        for a, b in backend.coupling_map.get_edges():\n            if a in health and b in health:\n                zz[(min(a, b), max(a, b))] = 1.0\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    return cand, health, flags, zz\n\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"EDGE QUANTUM GUARD — CELL 1 READY\")\nprint(\"Author: Arturo Salvador Balderas Hernandez\")\nprint(\"License: Elastic License 2.0\")\nprint(\"HARDWARE ONLY | budget 15s + 15s = 30s\")\nprint(\"=\" * 60)\nprint(\"Next → Cell 2 (Arm B on real QPU).\")","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-10T06:18:58.984637Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-10T06:18:58.985312Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-10T06:19:06.417514Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-10T06:18:58.985279Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-10T06:19:06.416609Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Note: you may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.\nConnecting to IBM Quantum — HARDWARE ONLY…\n","output_type":"stream"},{"name":"stderr","text":"qiskit_runtime_service._discover_account:WARNING:2026-10-10 06:19:03,312: Loading account with the given token. Interpretation and limitations\n\n| Outcome | Meaning |\n|---------|---------|\n| `HARDWARE_OK` | EQG path met the gate; baseline compared on real QPU within 30 s account |\n| `B_NOT_FAVORABLE` | EQG path under-performed; baseline correctly withheld |\n| `B_FAILED` | No usable assisted result; check token, backend, or queue |\n| `B_OK_A_SKIPPED` | Assisted OK but Arm A not run (budget or gate) |\n\n**Limitations**\n\n- Hardware claims require a valid IBM token and the same pre-registered thresholds.\n- QAOA angles are fixed (not a classical outer optimizer), by design, so 15 s ceilings remain honest.\n- Layout selection excludes qubits from *this job’s circuit only*; it does not power-down the device.\n- Queue wall-time can exceed account time on open plans; use `job_id`s in IBM Quantum to track jobs.\n\n**Roles (reminder)**\n\n- **Layout Guard** = who works (configuration).\n- **Conditional DD** = how they work (mitigation), without changing the set.","metadata":{}},{"id":"license","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 7.
